- **Panama Disease**: Leaf wilting and yellowing — leaf disease, not fruit tip rot.
- **Yellow & Black Sigatoka**: Yellow/dark lesions on leaves — leaf disease, not fruit.

The blossom-end necrosis on green fruit is diagnostic for Cigar End Rot.
